cn.t: Kushner's epic eight-hour masterwork receives a majestic, starry revival that confirms its canonical status. Critics praise Elliott's rigorous direction and Garfield's tour-de-force performance, finding the sprawling AIDS-era drama still prescient and theatrically dazzling.
